items.title: Stock under ₹100: Turtlemint hits 5% upper circuit as Q2 loss narrows 67%

items.title: Park Medi World shares plummet 10% as Q2 profit tanks 31%, margins slide
items.description: Park Medi World stock was listed on the Indian stock market on December 17 last year and continues to trade 58 per cent above the IPO price of ₹162 and 65 per cent above the listing price of ₹155.60.

items.title: Honasa, Nykaa rally up to 4% in subdued market; record 52-week highs

items.title: Alkem shares fall 3% after Q2 results; MOFSL retains Neutral rating

items.title: Hitachi Energy shares rally 12% on 86% rise in Q2 order inflows, PAT up 21%
items.description: Hitachi Energy's orders jumped 85.9 per cent to ₹4,120.8 crore in Q2FY27 from ₹2,217.1 crore a year ago. It secured a record-high backlog of ₹33,335.4 crore again, as of September 2026.
